title: Spalart–Allmaras diffusion limiter ratio
overview: A Real input passed to the Spalart–Allmaras limited-diffusion policy. The policy returns the minimum of rprod times production and the diffusion contribution.
principle: The source implementation is diff_limited = min(rprod * production, diffusion). This is a source-term limiter relation; the name alone does not establish a universal physical interpretation or recommended value.
architecture: TurbCom::Init reads rprod. The SA source-term path calls SaLimitedDiffusion, implemented in TurbSaPolicy.cpp. Applicability is limited to the audited SA path.

proves: The audited SA source-term path passes rprod to SaLimitedDiffusion.
does_not_prove: That the limiter is used by SST or other turbulence models.
